name: Thinning Veil
description: Thin the qi of the air round a foe until the foe loses all sense of direction.

name: Drain Sweep
description: Sweep a flat arc of nothing across the ground that drains strength from all it crosses.

name: Hollowing Wash
description: Wash a deep curse or binding from an ally into emptiness and leave no trace.

name: Gap Lash
description: Lash a cord of nothing round a foe and draw it into a gap in the ground.

name: Annulling Heaven
description: Hollow the sky above the ranks and annul the heavy techniques that fall from it.

name: Voidspear
description: Hurl a spear of nothing through plate and ward alike.

name: Silent Bulwark
description: Raise a bulwark of dead air round the user and allies that takes the force from any blow.

name: Heaven Hush
description: Hush the whole sky so that no technique of lesser force can rise under it.

name: Emptying Rend
description: Rend the target from within past every ward with a stroke of the hollowed sky.

name: Void Swallow
description: Swallow a great blast whole into the hollow and leave the air quiet.

name: Nothing Step
description: Cease to be at one spot and be again at another anywhere the hollow reaches.

name: Voided Heaven
description: The school's high move in which the sky above the field is hollowed and every technique below a great force fails to form.

name: Sky Unmaking
description: Unmake the sky and the ground beneath it so that a whole host falls into the gap at the full destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Tide Drain
description: Draw a slow tide of nothing over a foe and carry off the foe's strength.

name: Quiet Wash
description: Wash an ally in a still tide that carries off curse and taint together.

name: Undertow Lock
description: Hold a foe in an undertow of nothing that seals the qi inside the body.

name: Ebbing Strike
description: Strike as the tide ebbs so that the blow draws the strength of the target out with it.

name: Drowning Hush
description: Sink the field under a heavy hush in which no technique can be drawn.

name: Abyss Lance
description: Drive a lance out of the depths of the sea of nothing through all that stands before it.

name: Void Mantle
description: Wrap the user and allies in a mantle of the sea's own calm that turns heavy blows.

name: Unmaking Rain
description: Let drops of unmaking fall over the field and eat away what they touch.

name: Abyssal Rend
description: Rend a target from within with a pull from the bottom of the sea.

name: Swallowing Void
description: Draw the force of a mighty blast into the sea and let it vanish in the dark.

name: Voidtide Phase
description: Ebb through a solid barrier as a tide runs through sand.

name: Unmaking Tide
description: The school's greatest move in which a tide of unmaking rolls over the land and drains the strength of all it covers.

name: Nothing Tide
description: Roll a tide of nothing over the whole land so that all it covers is drained of form and strength at the full destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Oblivion Rift
description: Tear one deep rift of oblivion through the land and all that stands on it to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.
